judged_text: In the no-credentialId destination branch, createEvent is called as `createEvent(c, event)` without destination.externalId, so GoogleCalendarService.createEvent's `find(cal => cal.credentialId === credentialId)` cannot match (the destination has no credentialId by definition of this branch) and falls back to 'primary'. Legacy bookings created before the refactor whose DestinationCalendar rows have no credentialId but do have a specific externalId now get their events created on the user's primary calendar instead of the selected calendar — a silent regression for pre-existing data.

adjudication.rationale: In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, when iterating destinations with no `destination.credentialId`, it calls `createEvent(c, event)` without passing `destination.externalId` (diff: `createdEvents = createdEvents.concat(await Promise.all(destinationCalendarCredentials.map(async (c) => await createEvent(c, event))))`). Meanwhile `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent(calEventRaw, credentialId)` now selects `calendarId` via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find(cal => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` and falls back to `"primary"` when no match is found. For a `DestinationCalendar` entry that has an `externalId` but no `credentialId`, this lookup cannot succeed and will silently create on the primary calendar instead of the specified external calendar—behavior change/regression introduced by this diff.
